editor.title: Map Annotation Editor
editor.confirmClearFloor: Clear every marker on "{floor}"? (walls/openings/labels/placements/drawings all get removed — other floors are unaffected)
editor.confirmClearDrawings: Clear all drawings on "{floor}"? (other markers are unaffected)
editor.alertSelectGadgetFirst: Pick a gadget to place first.
editor.alertFillFloorIdAndName: Fill in the floor id and name first

help.wall: Reinforce: drag once = one wall segment. After drawing, select it — drag the two white end handles to fine-tune length/angle, drag the "Wall" badge at the midpoint to move the whole segment, and set the panel count (Wall×N) in the right panel.
help.opening: Opening: pick one of vault/walkthrough/gunfight/foot/floor, click to place — picked the wrong type? select it and change it after.
help.textLabel: Text label: click to place, edit the text on the right to name a room.
help.placement: Placement: pick an operator on the right, then a gadget, click to place — drag to set facing.
help.handles: Selecting any marker shows handles: white = resize, blue = rotate facing/vision cone. Placements get an extra orange handle to rotate the icon itself, independent of facing. Handles auto-fade after 3s idle — click the icon or drag a handle to bring them back.
help.draw: Draw: pen/highlighter — hold and drag to freehand; line/arrow/rectangle/ellipse — press, drag, release; eraser — click a stroke to delete it. Everything supports Ctrl+Z.
help.clickBehavior: In any tool, pointing at an existing marker always selects/drags it instead of stacking a duplicate — click empty space to create a new one.
help.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Esc / right-click cancels and returns to Select · Delete removes · Ctrl+Z undoes
